hero.title: Ninety seconds at
hero.lede: We stretch 72-hour dough by hand, spiral on raw San Marzano and bake every pie over an oak fire until the crust goes leopard. Scroll and make one with us.

stages.title: Dough ball
stages.text: 250 g of 00 flour dough, cold-proofed for 72 hours at 4 °C.

stages.title: Stretch
stages.text: By hand, from the middle out. No rolling pin, so the rim keeps its air.

stages.title: Sauce
stages.text: Raw San Marzano DOP, crushed by hand. One ladle, one spiral, rim left bare.

stages.title: Toppings
stages.text: Torn fior di latte, spicy salame cups and a few basil leaves. Dropped, never arranged.

stages.title: Into the fire
stages.text: Off the peel onto the oven floor. Oak burning on the left, floor at 485 °C.

stages.title: Bake
stages.text: Turned once at 45 seconds. The rim puffs, blisters and goes leopard.

stages.title: Out
stages.text: Fresh basil and a thread of olive oil. Eat it in the next four minutes.

menu.title: Eight pies. No pineapple.
menu.body: Every pie starts as the same 250 g ball. Rosse get raw San Marzano DOP tomatoes, crushed by hand. Bianche skip the tomato and lean on smoked provola and good oil. Each one is about 30 cm and meant for one person.

pies.name: Marinara
pies.desc: San Marzano DOP, garlic, Sicilian oregano, extra virgin olive oil. No cheese, on purpose.

pies.name: Margherita
pies.desc: San Marzano DOP, fior di latte from Agerola, basil, Parmigiano Reggiano 24 months, olive oil.

pies.name: Diavola Sfacciata
pies.desc: San Marzano, fior di latte, spicy salame cups, Calabrian chili, hot honey after the bake.

pies.name: Cosacca
pies.desc: San Marzano, Pecorino Romano, basil, olive oil. Older than the Margherita and still underrated.

pies.name: 'Nduja e Burrata
pies.desc: San Marzano, fior di latte, 'nduja from Spilinga, a whole burrata torn on after the oven.

pies.name: Salsiccia e Friarielli
pies.desc: Smoked provola, fennel sausage, friarielli sautéed with garlic and chili. The Naples classic.

pies.name: Funghi e Provola
pies.desc: Smoked provola, roast mushrooms, thyme, Parmigiano, a little black pepper.

pies.name: Mortazza
pies.desc: Fior di latte, then mortadella, stracciatella and pistachio crumb once it leaves the oven.

build.eyebrow: Build your own · tap to drop
build.title: Throw things
build.body: Tap a topping and a portion lands on the pie. Up to three portions of each. The price updates as you go, and the bake button gives it the full 90 seconds at 485 °C (sped up).

party.title: How many pies is
party.body: Tell us the headcount and how hungry they are. We'll tell you how many pies, how long the oven needs and how much dough we set aside.

order.title: Pick a slot.
order.body: Our oven bakes three pies every 90 seconds, so each 15-minute slot holds 24 pies. Pick a time with room and we fire yours so they come out as you walk in.

columns.label: Rules
lines: Eat it in the first four minutes.

footer.fine: Forno Sfacciato is a made-up business for a concept site.
